<div class="site-wrap">
<header class="site-masthead">
  <span class="pill">Architecture 2.0</span>

<section class="site-hero">
  <div class="hub-kicker">Workloads &amp; Benchmarks Portal</div>
  <h1>Workloads &amp; Benchmarks</h1>
  <p class="subtitle">Standard evaluation targets across the AI-native systems and chip design lifecycle</p>
</section>

<p class="site-lede">
Architecture 2.0 requires an architecture-grade evidence standard. Whether evaluating an LLM for Verilog generation, an agentic loop for kernel autotuning, or surrogate models for physical macro placement, progress depends on transparent baselines, reproducible traces, and rigorous contamination screening. This portal curates standard workloads and benchmark suites across the complete hardware stack.
</p>

<div class="registry-legend" aria-label="Portal governance">
  <strong>Benchmark governance and evidence criteria</strong>
  <span><b>Matching:</b> evaluations must report matched baseline comparators and compute budgets (<a href="/book/contents/chapters/10-evaluation/10-evaluation.html#sec-matched-baseline-comparisons">Chapter 10</a>).</span>
  <span><b>Contamination:</b> hardware code generation benchmarks require memorization checks (such as CDD) and null-module sensitivity audits.</span>
  <span><b>Consortium alignment:</b> advancing open infrastructure for closed-loop architecture exploration (<a href="/book/contents/chapters/12-ecosystem/12-ecosystem.html#sec-neutral-governance">Chapter 12</a>).</span>
</div>

<script>
window.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  var listing = window.quartoListings?.["listing-benchmark-catalog"] ||
    window["quarto-listings"]?.["listing-benchmark-catalog"];
  var input = document.querySelector("#listing-benchmark-catalog .search");
  if (!listing || !input) {
    return;
  }
  input.addEventListener("input", function () {
    listing.search(input.value);
  });
});
</script>
